bio.text: John Nagel is the Republican candidate for Minnesota's 5th Congressional District in 2026, facing Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar in the general election.
Nagel, who is from St. Louis Park, is a former Minnesota state trooper who told Fox News Digital he spent 30 years in that job.

sources.title: Minnesota congressional races set after Tuesday primary. Here's who is running in each district
Ex-state trooper John Nagel wins the primary to challenge Ilhan Omar
